function: Actor-critic DRL allocates the last UAV's NOMA transmit power among users to minimize the maximum user decoding outage probability (pp. 3-4).
system: BS, 2-4 hovering UAV relays on decode-and-forward FSO hops; last UAV serves three users by RF NOMA with imperfect SIC; no RIS; 200 kHz bandwidth (pp. 2-4).
method: Actor-critic DRL: actor (3 hidden layers of 16 neurons) outputs power levels, critic (128 neurons) approximates the reward; offline training on random states with exploration noise (p. 4).
data_channel: Random state vectors (turbulence, distances, Nakagami-m) with reward from closed-form outage expressions; FSO gamma-gamma with pointing error, RF Nakagami-m; no dataset or measurements (pp. 2-4).
test_conditions: Trained on random states; evaluated by outage curves versus FSO parameters alpha (0.3-13) and beta (1-13) and threshold (0.05, 0.07); training range of states not stated (pp. 4-5).
baselines: Non-learned: exhaustive search. Learned: none compared; the DDPG work [14] is only cited (pp. 1, 5).
metrics: Minimum of the maximum user decoding outage probability, its difference from exhaustive search (2.3-4.1 percent), average reward per 100 training steps (p. 5).
complexity: none; only a qualitative remark that training is the main cost and online computation is simple (p. 4).
q1_support: p. 2: "we consider a composite optical channel model [17] for FSO links"; the RF links use path loss with Nakagami-m fading (p. 2), so the channels are custom statistical models, with no 3GPP model, public ray-tracing set or measured data.
q2_support: p. 4: "the trained policy model should be suitable for most applications" is only a claim; Figs. 3-5 (p. 5) sweep alpha, beta, the threshold and 2 to 4 relays, but the paper never says a policy trained on one setting is tested on another, and the training range of states is not given.
q3_support: p. 1: "the validity of the proposed approach are verified by comparing it with exhaustive search algorithm"; Figs. 3-5 (p. 5) compare only the DRL policy with exhaustive search (non-learned), and no earlier learned method is compared.
q4_support: p. 4: "The online computations are very simple without involving any iteration"; this is qualitative, and no complexity order, operation count, parameter count or runtime is reported.
q5_support: p. 4: "We randomly generate the state vector"; training data are generated from statistical models, and the paper gives no link or DOI for code or data and uses no public dataset.
notes: Area 6: the learned actor-critic sets the transmit powers of the last UAV in an aerial relay network, a physical-layer decision in aerial links, so it passes above_phy and function (p. 3). The optimized variables are the RF NOMA powers; the FSO hops enter only through the outage probability. The number of antennas is not stated (scalar link gains), and area 6 admits single-antenna links. q3: only exhaustive search is compared; the DDPG work [14] is cited, not compared. q4: qualitative statement only.
